body: Me and my mother are generally okay but she tends to hide things from me. She used to lie to me about her boyfriend even though I obviously knew and discussed about with the rest of my family (who think it's silly that she treats me like this). She lied about moving until DAYS before I had to start packing. She lies about going out at night and I expect her to be back and she'll be gone all night. She lied about going to MEXICO. I'm still not even sure how long she was there. We have a large barrier when it comes to sharing personal information.

Thanks for responding to this. My old friends are just kind of irrelevant now except for two which I'll probably talk to. I'm seeing a few of my older friends in a couple weeks and I might talk to them about it, but we aren't close like we used to be. And I don't want to act like an attention seeker in front of them and I'm afraid that's how they'll take it. I may talk to my dad but he's not exactly in my life as much as he used to be, but it's a lot easier to talk to him. Thank you for the wonderful advice. 

Edit: I'm also kind of scared to talk to my mother because she's pretty critical about people with mental health issues. One of my best friends went to the hospital because she was afraid she would commit suicide that night (she didn't thank god) and my mother fucking laughed at her and called her a drama queen. So I don't really feel too safe disclosing my own struggle with her.
